SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUANDIKA 2.3.1 INSHA ZA KIUAMILIFU BARUA YA KIRAFIKI
This lesson teaches Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki for Grade 9 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

Example 1: Describe Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki above.
2. Explain Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 2.3.1 Insha za Kiuamilifu Barua ya kirafiki
